column1: # Story recap pages 1532-1604: narration (style page, whole texture), transcribed from the sprite

column4: ガーロット率いるブレイズ義賊団は…
column5: The Blaze Justice Corps, led by Garlot, was hired by the noble Margrave Velleman and reborn as his private army. And so Gram Blaze was born.\nBack in Tiera, they received their first orders: escort Velleman on his journey to the imperial capital.\nOn what seemed a simple mission, Garlot and the others learned the hard way that law and order were crumbling not only in Tiera, but across the whole Empire.

column4: セリカとの三度目の対決に割って入ったのは…
column5:
The one who cut into their third showdown with Cerica was none other than the man at the very summit of the Bronquia Empire: Emperor Soltier himself.
They had no love for the Emperor's arrogant, insolent manner, but it was plain that there was nothing they could do against such overwhelming power.
Meanwhile, his business in the capital Flarewerk finished, Margrave Velleman ordered the private army to escort him once more on his way back to Tiera.
On the road home, passing through Albelt's domain, Garlot came upon two girls.

column4: アルベルト貴族領にて…
column5:
In Albelt's domain, they had saved two sisters, Luciana and Aegina, from a mysterious band hunting them, and by Margrave Velleman's leave the two joined Gram Blaze.
The army had grown stronger than anyone expected, yet the Margrave himself felt its strength was still far from enough.
So he set his sights on a man known as the "Berserker": once captain of the capital guard, demoted by the current emperor, and now commanding an army at a garrison on the northern frontier.
His plan was to recruit a man well versed in war and raise the level of the private army's training.
Under the pretext of a nobles' inspection of the training, the Margrave sent them to the northern frontier garrison, with orders to invite the man to join if he proved worthy of trust, and to leave at once if he did not.

column4: 地方都市ティエラのニーベル街区で…
column5:
In the Nibel Quarter of the provincial city of Tiera, gold and valuables kept vanishing from nobles' homes late at night. Rumour had it that an organised band of thieves was hatching a careful plan.
Margrave Velleman ordered the private army to patrol the city at night: find out whether the rumour was true, and if it was, catch the thieves.
His real aim was to put the nobles of Tiera in his debt, so that they would quietly accept his keeping a private army.
And so Garlot and the private army took to patrolling the streets by night.

column4: 私兵団の戦力は日増しに高まっていたが…
column5: The private army grew stronger by the day, but there was no denying that its strength leaned toward brute force. So Margrave Velleman began to think about forming a unit of mages, which the army lacked.\nCharged with finding a captain for the new unit, Garlot heard a rumour that a gifted mage, an eccentric who could wield a cannon of tremendous power at will, was living in seclusion, and set out for the Erruk Mountains towering in the north.\nBut Gram Blaze had not yet noticed the band creeping up on them since they left town...

column4: 神生教団との突然の遭遇により…
column5:
A sudden run-in with the Blessed Papal Army left Garlot and the others in a tight spot. The one who saved them was Eudy: the very mage they had been looking for.
To Garlot's offer to join, Eudy named her condition: "Raid the neighbouring kingdom's supply convoy and steal its cargo."
Among the cargo, she said, was a magic item called "Urd's Tear," which she needed to improve the cannon she was building.
Gram Blaze slipped across to the Nilrud Desert, the most deserted spot on the convoy's route, to lie in wait for their target...

column4: 地方都市ティエラを訪ねる予定だった…
column5: An acquaintance of Margrave Velleman, who was due to visit the provincial city of Tiera, vanished in the snowfields of Mount Jikkart, which towers over the north of the Empire.\nNear the summit of Mount Jikkart the border with the neighbouring kingdom is very unclear, and the area is known as a danger zone, haunted by smugglers and by the thieves who prey on their goods.\nGarlot and the others hurried to the scene with Margrave Velleman to search for him. But a raging blizzard barred their way.

column4: ヴェルマン方伯の遠縁に当たる…
column5: The lands ruled by Count Anis, a distant relative of Margrave Velleman, had lately been raided again and again by a band of thieves.\nBegged by Count Anis, who had heard of the private army's valour, to send troops, Margrave Velleman sent Garlot and the others out, saying, "It never hurts to have someone in your debt."\nGram Blaze left Tiera and headed west, toward Count Anis's lands...

column4: アニス伯爵領に到着したグラムブレイズは…
column5: Arriving in Count Anis's lands, Gram Blaze ran into the thieves in the middle of a raid and drove them off. But the lord, Count Anis, had already abandoned the town, and it lay in ruins, the light gone from its people's eyes.\nAngered by the lord's attitude and the thieves' deeds alike, Garlot was painfully reminded once more of how powerless they were.\nAccording to Siskier's scouting, the thieves had fled into the Kred forest, which spreads to the west of the town. On his own judgement Garlot mobilised the private army, and to drive out the thieves they pushed deep into the forest...

column4: ブロンキア帝国第二の都市であり…
column5:
Tiera: the second city of the Bronquia Empire, and its centre of trade.
The lands west of Tiera, being far from the capital, had long been lawless, and had become a gathering place for those who rebelled against the Empire.
In the west, one rebel force had grown especially strong these past few years. Rumoured to be funded by the neighbouring kingdom, and backed by ample money and careful organisation, it was slowly but surely widening its reach.
In the capital, the rebels were branded "organised bandits," and men of goodwill across the land were called on to march against them. Naturally, the call also went out to Margrave Velleman's private army, said to be among the best.
If the fighting spread, Tiera would be on the front line. Garlot set out for Mount Tokino, where the rebel army had built its forward base.

column4: 所用の為、バリン公爵領の街に向かう…
column5:
Ordered to escort Margrave Velleman to a town in Duke Balin's lands on business, Gram Blaze met no thieves on the way and reached the duchy safely.
But during their stay, the Margrave suddenly ordered them to find a man called "Barefoot Mizer."
The man, they said, was the head of a band of pickpockets that had lately been stirring up the towns around.
It seemed that "Barefoot Mizer" had stolen something precious from the Margrave as well.
At the order of a Margrave more flustered than they had ever seen him, Garlot and the others began the search for Mizer.

column4: バリン公爵領での探索によって…
column5:
Searching Duke Balin's lands, Gram Blaze under Garlot ran into the pickpocket "Barefoot Mizer," and after a chase they caught him.
With Mizer as their guide, they headed for the Dorominos Marshes, home of the "hideout" where he had piled up his loot.
With their poison swamps, the Dorominos Marshes were known as a place so dangerous that even thieves shunned them for the foul air.
Would the Margrave's precious possession be among the loot Mizer had hoarded? Gram Blaze set foot in the cursed marshes...

column4: 帝都東の有力貴族バリン公爵の領地に…
column5:
Cargo, it seemed, was being shipped up the river in secret to the lands of Duke Balin, a powerful noble east of the capital.
What the cargo held was unclear, but it seemed to be Duke Balin's tribute to the Emperor.
Margrave Velleman ordered them to attack the transport ship and destroy the cargo. His aim was to wreck the standing of Duke Balin, his greatest rival at present.
Angered by Duke Balin, who sought the Emperor's favour with the people's taxes, Garlot and the others laid a trap near the mouth of the Alto River, on the transport route.

column4: 神生教団との闘争に巻き込まれ…
column5: The lands of Marquis Albelt, who lost his life when caught up in the struggle with the Blessed Papal Army, had long been left without a lord.\nBut Margrave Velleman, guardian of his adopted daughters Aegina and her sister, kept loudly pressing their right to inherit, and at last their title to the land was recognised.\nAt Margrave Velleman's order, Garlot went to the marquisate as his deputy, to collect the taxes owed from the years without a lord.

column4: ヴェルマン方伯の名代として徴税に訪れた…
column5:
Arriving as Margrave Velleman's deputy to collect the taxes, Gram Blaze was met by an attack of armed militia.
It was an uprising of the people under the banner of self-rule, and a battle Garlot and the others had never wanted.
But puzzled by how well equipped the militia were, Garlot and the others smelled a plot: someone was at work behind the uprising.
To stop any more needless bloodshed, and to find the ringleader, the private army pressed on toward the heart of the town.

column4: グラムブレイズの各団員は…
column5: In peacetime, the members of Gram Blaze stand by at their headquarters outside Tiera.\nThey are used to rushing from battle to battle almost every day, but of course there are days with no mission, too.\nThat day, with Captain Garlot away in Tiera, everyone was enjoying a brief rest. None of them could have known that a silent army was closing in on them.

column4: 各地で戦果を上げるグラムブレイズは…
column5:
With every victory Gram Blaze won across the land, Margrave Velleman's fame and standing among the nobles rose.
But the Margrave was not satisfied.
Gram Blaze lacked a brain: someone rich in experience and skilled at debating strategy and making plans, who could be the Margrave's right hand.
Hearing a rumour that a prophet of great power was living in seclusion in the Kred forest, northwest of Tiera, Margrave Velleman sent Garlot to recruit them.

column4: グラムブレイズは、預言者を探す道中で…
column5: On their way to find the prophet, Gram Blaze ran into Cerica's unit, which was out for revenge on Garlot and the others, and drove it off.\nTheir own fight, waged under the banner of a just cause, had ended up hurting people. Garlot felt that keenly, but Siskier lifted his spirits, and he was reminded how precious the comrades who stood beside him were.\nIn search of the man said to be a prophet, the group pushed deep into the Kred forest...

column4: クレドの森の深部で、預言者ネシアとの…
column5:
Deep in the Kred forest, Garlot and the others met the prophet Nessiah, passed his hard "trial" of defeating corpse soldiers, and won his promise of help.
They also met again with Eimi, the girl who had once saved them from a tight spot. Following Nessiah's prophecy, "Stay with the private army and you will meet your brother," Eimi too joined Gram Blaze.
On the road home to the provincial city of Tiera, Gram Blaze caught sight of an armed band.
It was a unit of the Blessed Papal Army, relentlessly hunting Luciana and Aegina.
But by good fortune, the unit had shown no sign yet of noticing Garlot and the others.
Seeing his chance, Jenon proposed a surprise attack on the Papal Army.

column4: ヴェルマン方伯が大公と共に…
column5:
Margrave Velleman was to travel abroad with the Grand Duke, and while he was away, Gram Blaze was given leave.
With time on her hands, Siskier declared, "Let's go shopping, girls only!" and so the women set off into the streets of Tiera on their own.
They wandered all over town, savouring their first free time in ages.
But off duty, the girls never noticed: a group of young girls was more than charming enough to get the thugs who swarmed the streets all worked up...

column4: ヴェルマン方伯が大公と共に…
column5: Margrave Velleman was to travel abroad with the Grand Duke, and while he was away, Gram Blaze was given leave.\nWorn out by the women's excitement over their shopping trip, the men decided to enter a martial tournament held near the capital, which would double as real combat training for the recruits. It was an unusual tournament, a contest of skill between mercenaries.\nWill Garlot and the others be the last ones standing?

column4: ブロンキア帝国の西部地域では…
column5:
In the west of the Bronquia Empire, as the Empire's grip slowly weakened, the spirit of rebellion was spreading like wildfire.
Its core, the rebel army, was said to stop at nothing, plunder included, and to make the local people suffer even more than the Empire did.
Weighing the situation, Nessiah urged that putting down the rebels was the quickest road to fame, and Margrave Velleman resolved to send his army.
Advancing on Kernuga, a farming city under the rebels' rule, Gram Blaze found a familiar face among the rebel ranks facing them...

column4: ケルヌガの解放に成功したグラムブレイズは…
column5: Having freed Kernuga, Gram Blaze chased the retreating rebels toward Sharminel, a mountain city in the west of the Jikkart Range.\nSharminel is a natural fortress city, ringed by steep mountain roads and hard-to-cross snowfields.\nGram Blaze set foot in the mountains where the rebel army lay in wait. There, a battle fiercer than any before awaited them...

column4: 帝都とティエラを繋ぐ交易ルートに出没する…
column5:
The mountain bandits haunting the trade route between the capital and Tiera had grown greatly in number these past few months. The army showed no sign of moving against them, and order in the Empire only grew worse.
One after another, merchants pulled out of the trade route as their losses mounted, and the Empire's economy quickly went cold.
Facing this crisis for the trading city of Tiera, Margrave Velleman ordered Gram Blaze to restore order by putting down the bandits.
Garlot and the others drew up a plan to lure the bandits out with false word of a "gold shipment" and catch them all in one sweep...

column4: 金塊の噂に誘き出された…
column5: The plan to lure out the bandits with rumours of gold and catch them all in one sweep was a great success.\nWorried for Garlot, who had fallen to the bottom of the gorge, Siskier and the others camped at the end of the cliff road and sent out a search party to find him.\nBut a force clearly not of the bandits was creeping up on them...

column4: 近頃、西部からティエラに入る…
column5:
Lately, the price of salt coming into Tiera from the west had shot up.
Margrave Velleman's inquiries revealed that the imperial officials running the checkpoint on the Tokino River were in league with the salt merchants, levying illegal taxes and lining their own pockets.
A soaring price for salt, a necessity of life, was a heavy blow to the people of the Nether District, and to the whole economy of Tiera.
On Margrave Velleman's orders, the private army set out to investigate the Tokino Checkpoint.

column4: 帝都フレアヴェルク近郊で…
column5:
Near the capital Flarewerk, the Emperor was to hold large-scale military exercises.
The regular army, the nobles' private armies and the militias were to gather in one place, in the name of better keeping the peace. But by Margrave Velleman's and Nessiah's reading, the true aim was to smoke out the rebels.
An imperial order reached Margrave Velleman too, commanding him to send Gram Blaze. To refuse an imperial order would be treason...
And so Garlot and the others went up to the capital Flarewerk to take part in the exercises...

column4: 帝都での軍事演習からほどなくして…
column5:
Not long after the exercises in the capital, Lapis, captain of the Emperor's guard, came to Tiera at the head of an army.
Margrave Velleman was suspected of rebellion, and was to answer for himself before the Imperial Assembly.
Refusing would be as good as admitting the charge was true. The Margrave obeyed, and resolved to go up to the capital with the private army.
But at that very moment, a menacing shadow was closing in on the provincial city of Tiera...

column4: 遂に反乱軍は威信をかけ…
column5:
At last the rebel army staked its pride on a great invasion of Tiera.
It was just what Margrave Velleman and Nessiah had long feared.
Calling the invasion "a danger to the nation," Margrave Velleman defied the summons from the capital and ordered the private army to fight back.
In the burning city of Tiera, the curtain was about to rise on the final battle between Gram Blaze and the rebel army...

column4: ティエラの復興に尽力していた…
column5:
As Gram Blaze worked hard to rebuild Tiera, an unexpected visitor came to them: Elena, sister of the Black Knight Leon.
Leon had taken Elena out of the rebel base, and since then, she said, the two had been secretly watching the rebels' movements.
From what she told them, the rebel remnants were gathering at the foot of Mount Tokino.
To join up with Leon, who was still keeping watch, and settle things with the rebel army once and for all, Gram Blaze hurried to Mount Tokino...

column4: トキノ山に急行した私兵団は…
column5:
Rushing to Mount Tokino, the private army rescued Leon just before he could be purged.
Losing the fight, Pandra abandoned his soldiers and fled the battlefield. Whether he lived or died was unknown, but with that, the rebel army fell apart.
Back in Tiera, Garlot received his next orders.
He was to guard the manor while Velleman held a secret meeting with a certain person.
With the capital already eyeing them warily, the tension was rising, and a menacing shadow swept through the streets of Tiera...

column4: グラムブレイズとの戦いによって…
column5:
After the battle with Gram Blaze, Pandra abandoned his army and fled, and the collapse of the rebel army was complete.
But Pandra's army was not the only one that sought to bring down the Empire.
Men of purpose who had lain low across the land were rising up, and a movement had begun to form a new rebel alliance.
And Garlot's name had come up as a candidate for its commander.
But Garlot was thinking: if he accepted the command, would the world he had been striving for truly come?...

column4: グラムブレイズは、反乱連合結成の報を掴んだ…
column5: Gram Blaze was surrounded by the imperial army, which had caught word of the rebel alliance being formed, and the private army's manor fell in flames.\nGram Blaze was crossing the Istraka Wastes, which spread northwest of Tiera, to join Siskier, who had gone on ahead.\nBut on the way, all contact with Siskier was lost.

column4: ヴェルマンの裏切りと、永遠の決別…
column5:
Velleman's betrayal, and a parting forever. And with Siskier's death, Garlot and the others were plunged into deep grief.
Having lost their headquarters, Garlot and the others called for a rebel alliance, and set about gathering soldiers and supplies.
Meanwhile, Garlot led part of the army to the land of Lost Aries,
to break the seal holding back the demon dragon's power that had awakened in the battle with Velleman.

column4: 母殺しの禁忌を犯して…
column5:
Breaking the taboo of killing his own mother, Garlot awakened the power of the demon dragon's blood and took up his true name: Gulcasa.
In the Bronquia Empire, Nessiah's lightning schemes paid off: the rebel alliance rose up across the land all at once, closing a vast ring around the capital.
Splitting its forces among the rebel alliances, the imperial army decided to send Baldus, the God of War, to crush the main force of the commander Gulcasa.
And so the main forces of both sides came face to face before the triumphal gate of the capital Flarewerk.

column4: ガルカーサ率いる反乱連合の本隊は…
column5:
The main force of the rebel alliance under Gulcasa broke through the triumphal gate held by Baldus and forced its way into the capital.
Against them, Emperor Soltier took the field at the head of his own army.
With Lapis, captain of his guard, he took up the defence of Flarewerk Castle.
The Emperor, bound by a pact with the demon dragon; and Gulcasa, who had awakened the demon dragon's blood sleeping in his own body.
The last battle for the rule of the Empire was about to begin...

column4: 帝都フレアヴェルク入りを果たした…
column5:
Having entered the capital Flarewerk, Gulcasa struck down Emperor Soltier, the symbol of tyranny, and proclaimed the founding of a new Bronquia Empire.
Gulcasa reigned as the new emperor: a strong nation, ruled under his might, where no one would be oppressed.
Not only the rebel soldiers, but the people who had wept under the old regime, too, gave their hearts to Gulcasa, who had carried the revolution through. With such fervent support, the new Empire seemed set for smooth sailing.
Yet there were some who felt uneasy about his rule, and about the fervour...

column4: パンドラが失踪した事により…
column5:
With Pandra gone, the remnants of the former rebel army had run wild, and order in the west, it was said, was worse than ever.
To keep Pandra from rising again and to build ties, Margrave Velleman set out on a tour of the western cities, with the private army at his side.
Restoring order city by city while forging firm ties, Velleman and the others ended their expedition of about a month and returned to Tiera.
The members of Gram Blaze were looking forward to going home to the manor...

column4: ルシエナの死から一夜が明け…
column5:
The night after Luciana's death, a fresh shock struck Gram Blaze: Aegina had suddenly vanished.
Ruled by thoughts of revenge, there was only one place she could be going...
Garlot made ready to go after Aegina, but Margrave Velleman held him back.
For the private army to clash with the Kingdom's army would stray far from the Margrave's course... and abandoning Aegina would also quiet the fighting with the Blessed Papal Army... So the private army would not be allowed to march, he said.
But Garlot ignored him, and decided on his own to go after Aegina.

column4: 王都への進軍を決定した一同は…
column5:
Having decided to march on the royal capital, the group raised Aegina as heir to the throne, and Garlot became captain of the Royal Guard.
Karona Castle, on the way to the royal capital Paltina, was a great obstacle. But on Jenon's bold advice, "If it's too strong, just don't go through it," they crossed by water in ships found on the spot, and got past Karona without a fight.
Garlot and the others pressed on toward the royal capital by forced march. Meanwhile Russell, noticing the surprise attack on the capital, quickly formed a unit to pursue them.
The two sides were about to cross swords on Rodney Road, south of Karona...

Taking her true name, Emilia regained her sealed power.
Thanks to her, Garlot and the others escaped their tight spot.
Fired up by their new strength, Gram Blaze marched on the royal capital.
Though they were blocked once, the lightning strike Jenon proposed paid off, and at last the group closed in on the royal capital Paltina.
The enemy's attack threw the capital into confusion.
But far outnumbered as they were, Garlot and the others had to end the fight before the confusion died down. In other words, they needed a quick battle.

column4: 王都正門を突破したガーロット達は…
column5:
Breaking through the main gate of the royal capital, Garlot and the others felt uneasy at how little resistance they met.
The group was wary of an enemy trap, when word came that Aegina had vanished.
Driven by revenge against the Kingdom, Aegina had charged into the castle's inner throne room. In the place she reached at last, Aegina had a reunion.
Meanwhile Garlot and the others, searching for Aegina, dared to storm the castle, where the Blessed Papal Army lurked in the shadows...

column4: 黒幕であるアランゼームの打倒…
column5:
With the fall of Alanjame, the mastermind, and the death of Ordene, Aegina's revenge was over.
The Kingdom's wounds ran deep. But reconciled with the surviving Princess Yggdra and with the Queen, her mother, Aegina swore to work for her return to the royal family and for the rebuilding of the country, and gave herself to it day after day.
Bearing the grief of losing its king, the Kingdom was taking a new step forward, on the road to peace.
But there were some who did not welcome it...

column4: ブロンキア帝国皇帝ソルティエが…
column5:
Word reached Margrave Velleman that Soltier, Emperor of the Bronquia Empire, had fallen ill.
The illness, it was said, was a fatal one, brought on by the side effects of the pact with the demon dragon that the emperors had made generation after generation.
Left alone, the Emperor would die, and with no heir, civil war was certain.
And if he were the one to cure the Emperor, his voice in the realm would surely grow...
So Velleman summoned Baretreenu, a sorceress who specialised in the demon dragon, from a distant land to treat the Emperor.
She could not tell without seeing the illness herself, but Baretreenu seemed to think a cure was not impossible.
Gram Blaze returned to the private army's manor and quickly made ready to go up to the capital.

column4: ガーロット達と共に上洛を果たした…
column5:
Arriving in the capital with Garlot and the others, Baretreenu met Emperor Soltier and, from his strange appearance, suggested he needed a curse to quiet the demon dragon's blood.
The Emperor refused the curse at first, but persuaded by Lapis, captain of his guard, he made up his mind to undergo it.
Meanwhile, someone was spreading word of "Emperor Soltier's illness," which should have been a closely kept secret, and stirring up the people's fears: Pandra, who had led the rebel army.
Alive after all, he had used his clever tongue to rally the rebels across the land once more, and was marching on the capital.
While Baretreenu worked the curse, Gram Blaze waited for Pandra's army before the triumphal gate...
The curtain finally rose on the last bloody battle with the rebel army.

column4: 魔竜の血を鎮める呪手術は成功し…
column5: The curse to quiet the demon dragon's blood succeeded, and Emperor Soltier's life was saved.\nBut Baretreenu collapsed from exhaustion. She woke at last three days later, but her memory of the moments before the curse ended was hazy, it was said.\nThe Emperor woke the next day, and as he was recovering well, Garlot and the others were given leave to go home.

column4: 「戦乱の渦を巻き起こす」と言い…
column5: Saying he would "stir up a whirlpool of war," Nessiah suddenly raised the flag of rebellion.\nAnd Lapis, suddenly dismissed by the Emperor after the curse...\nSensing that something was wrong with Soltier, Gram Blaze hurried to Ishnart Fortress, where Emperor Soltier had gone for talks with the Kingdom of Fantasinia.

column4: カノッサ街道に密かに配置された…
column5:
Gram Blaze struck down the assassins secretly posted on the Canossa Road.
But not knowing he had been a target, King Ordene of the Kingdom of Fantasinia turned down Garlot's proposal, saying it "would go against the good faith of a nation," and entered Ishnart Fortress alone.
Waiting outside the castle, Garlot and the others could only trust their fate to Siskier and Jenon, who had slipped inside the fortress...
Will Siskier and Jenon be able to rescue Ordene?

column4: イシュナート要塞での死闘は…
column5:
The fight to the death at Ishnart Fortress ended with Emperor Soltier freed from Nessiah's control.
But the price was far too high.
Jenon, hit by an enemy attack, fell into a waterway and vanished.
With help from the imperial army, Gram Blaze searched desperately, but after a week there was still no sign of Jenon.
Siskier agonised that he might have sacrificed himself for her, and felt more responsible than anyone...

column4: ネシアの力の源ともいえる…
column5:
The holy sword Gran Centurio: the very source of Nessiah's power, one might say.
Seal the sword's power, and Nessiah's ambitions could be crushed.
The rite would be held at an altar to the sea god, in the Kingdom's lands.
Without a doubt, Nessiah would come to stop it.
Under guard by the Kingdom and the Empire both, the day of the rite came at last.
Gram Blaze's fight is not over yet.

column4: 旧帝国を打倒し、革命を成し遂げた…
column5:
Having overthrown the old Empire and carried the revolution through, Gulcasa founded the new Bronquia Empire and named himself Flame Emperor.
Many of his comrades took high posts in the new government, and swore to keep giving their all to make the new Empire thrive.
But Siskier, Jenon and Medoute, who had followed him since the private army began, were not among them.
Afterwards, under the might and good rule of Flame Emperor Gulcasa, the Bronquia Empire grew more prosperous than anyone would have thought possible so soon after the revolution, and became a threat to the countries around it...
It would be only three years later that it invaded the neighbouring Kingdom of Fantasinia and carried out a lightning plan of conquest...

column4: この後、ユグドラ王女は…
column5:
Afterwards, Princess Yggdra told the people everything: that her twin sister was alive, of her father the King's death, and of the plot of Chancellor Alanjame...
And she declared that the two princesses would support the Kingdom from now on.
The two princesses were met with the people's wild cheers.
Princess Aegina and Princess Yggdra. And at the two princesses' side stood Gram Blaze, as their Royal Guard.
With hope in their hearts!

column4: ガーロットとメデューテは旅を続ける…
column5:
Garlot and Medoute travel on.
Their destination is not a place.
Garlot's purpose, Medoute's purpose.
What power means, what blood means; what an end is, and what is the road there...
No doubt they will travel on, their thoughts crossing as they go.
What they met along the way may be told some other time.
For now, let it be written only that the two of them have just begun their journey.

column4: 宰相ヴェルマンの主導の元…
column5:
Led by Chancellor Velleman, the Bronquia Empire took a new step forward, together with the Kingdom of Fantasinia, with which it signed a pact of non-aggression.
Garlot, who fought on battlefield after battlefield as captain of Velleman's private army, Gram Blaze, will become a young general of the Empire, and surely go on giving his all for its stability.
I decided to leave the Empire, and my friends.
I'd be lying if I said I had no regrets.
But life is a long journey. The day will come when I see everyone again.
And when it does, they'll welcome me back with the same old smiles and racket.
What I gained in the Bronquia Empire: how important it is to believe in something and help it grow. Yes, the seeds of hope.
